integrity: The exact first-public date is taken from the publisher record for Liu--Chang, which explicitly defines total \((a,b)\)-Roman domination; the specialization \(a=1\), \(b=2\) is the total Roman notion used here. Primary MSC ownership is independently verified from the accepted full text of the 2016 total-Roman paper as 05C69. No publication date was inferred from a revision or issue date.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to finite connected chain graphs and counts total Roman dominating functions by weight. The computation through order 9 is corroborative only; the general result rests on the structural proof. Literature searches cannot exclude an obscure equivalent statement under substantially different terminology.
title: Total Roman domination polynomial of chain graphs
